in_marathi.name: Jagadisha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jagadisha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jagat (universe) + Ish (lord) = Jagadisha (Lord of the Universe). This powerful name is associated with divine kingship, cosmic consciousness, and the supreme ruler of all.
